summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building high-scale backend and platform systems using Golang, Java, Node.js, and Python. Work spans microservices, real-time APIs, and distributed event-driven architectures powering applications that serve millions of users.

Led Golang-based Notifications platform serving millions+ messages/day, ensuring 99.9%+ uptime.

Improved reliability and observability across messaging microservices using Kafka, Redis, and monitoring tools.
Built multi-tenant event-driven microservice using Kafka for catalog quality check — reduced tenant boarding time by 60%, improved efficiency by 23%.
Designed microservices from scratch to integrate third-party APIs (e.g. H&M Inventory API).
Implemented SAML auth with Reliance SSO using Istio in Kubernetes for microservice-to-microservice communication.

Migrated REST coupon API to gRPC pipeline; upgraded SwiggyOne service from Spring Boot v1 to v2.
Implemented CRUD APIs with filter and pagination for Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) microservices.
Built nested Questionnaire functionality using Depth First Search algorithm.
Used Kafka for microservice communication; developed frontend features in ReactJS.
Added multiple features to the CRM dashboard using Django.
Added real-time functionality using Django Channels.
